description: List the people who say they currently work at a company page, read FRESH at request time, each with name, headline, location and profile. Returns the first 1,000 people; page with `start`. Costs $0.0012 per live read. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

page.description: A company page's public name, or its page address.

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 1,000 people.
